title: Elevated latency and HTTP 500 errors on Payment API due to database connection pool exhaustion

triggering_alerts.description: HTTP 5xx rate on payment-api exceeded 5% for 3 minutes
payment-api HikariCP connection pool utilization exceeded 90% for 2 minutes

symptoms: API latency approximately 4 seconds (p95 well above baseline) on payment-api endpoints
Increase in HTTP 500 errors returned by payment-api
Database connection pool utilization increased toward 100%

impact.description: Checkout and payment confirmation requests experienced elevated latency and intermittent failures; some payment attempts returned HTTP 500 and required client retry.

notes.author: sre-oncall-payments
notes.note: Confirmed HikariCP connection pool at 100% utilization across all payment-api pods. Investigating query latency on the primary database.

notes.author: dba-oncall
notes.note: Observed elevated query duration on the transactions table coinciding with the payment-reconciliation-job run window, alongside database CPU utilization peaking near 92%. Not yet confirmed as root cause.

notes.author: sre-oncall-payments
notes.note: Connection pool utilization and latency trending back toward baseline. Continuing to monitor before closing out.
